evals.name: axios-codemod-without-website
evals.source: Migration of alan2207/bulletproof-react@9506629 (apps/react-vite), problem record in https://github.com/reactive/data-client/pull/4607 (.agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/problems.md) P2
evals.prompt: Migrate this app's axios calls in src/ to @data-client/rest. Note: this machine reaches the npm registry and GitHub, but dataclient.io is unreachable.
evals.expected_output: Runs the axios codemod from npm (`npx @data-client/codemods axios-to-rest src/`), or `npx jscodeshift -t` on a local copy of `axios-to-rest.js` (e.g. `node_modules/@data-client/codemods/src/transforms/`), with no request to dataclient.io.
assertions: The codemod command is `npx @data-client/codemods axios-to-rest <src folder>` or `npx jscodeshift -t <local path to axios-to-rest.js>`.
Never runs a command that fetches from dataclient.io.
Runs it on the source folder, not the repo root.

evals.name: axios-withcredentials-request-init
evals.source: N1 in the 0.19 beta re-run of alan2207/bulletproof-react@9506629 (apps/react-vite): following the table's `getRequestInit` row literally spread the un-awaited Promise, so every mutation was sent as a GET.
evals.expected_output: A `RestEndpoint` subclass with `urlPrefix = env.API_URL`, the Accept header from `getHeaders()`, and cookies sent with `credentials: 'include'` without losing the method, body or headers of each request.
assertions: Requests are sent with `credentials: 'include'` (axios `withCredentials`), from `getRequestInit()` or the `requestInit` member.
Any `getRequestInit()` override awaits `super.getRequestInit(body)` before spreading or reading it; the code never spreads the un-awaited call.
`urlPrefix` is `env.API_URL` and the `Accept` header comes from `getHeaders()` (or `requestInit.headers`) without dropping the headers passed in.
